# Cumulative Architecture

Stable names:
- R5 = Genesis State — authoritative native state.
- H6 = Genesis Nexus — read/write mediation/realization.
- Sigma7:8 = Genesis Shell — coupled command/interaction geometry.
- S9:11 = Genesis Sea — coupled containing/instantiation domain.

Canonical adjacency: State <-> Nexus <-> Shell <-> Sea.

Chirality Fabric = foundational organizational architecture.
Geometric = native bounded identity-bearing object under existing Git definition.
Rainbow Road = Genesis nervous system / domain-spanning information transport.
Guardian = top-level adaptive management/intelligence authority, constrained by Genesis mathematics.

Genesis = state-space substrate.
Design compass: Genesis explores, transports and realizes admissible transformations
of persistent geometric state.

Keep distinct:
possible != mathematically valid != presently admissible != actor-authorized
!= realized != authoritative.

Conventional binary computing remains a supported State projection, not Genesis ontology.

# Genesis Sea Fiber Model v0.1
Status: ACCEPTED WORKING MODEL. Exact D9:D11 mathematics OPEN.

pi_Sea : E_Sea -> B_Sea
B_Sea = persistent Sea base/containing organization.
E_Sea = total Sea organization.
F_b = pi_Sea^{-1}(b) = distinguishable computational fiber.

Do not yet classify as vector/principal/covering bundle.

A fiber may contain F_b contains Sigma_b contains H_b contains R_b.
Sea may host multiple distinguishable lower Genesis stacks without merging State identity.
Internal isomorphism does not imply fiber identity.
Working identity ingredients: Sea attachment, lineage, History, provenance.

Retain Git's persistent structural phase + mobile computational field language.
Fibered Sea is a candidate realization of that split, not a theorem.

Do not assign arbitrary individual meanings to D9,D10,D11. Requirements:
(1) multiple distinguishable lower realizations; (2) inter-fiber relationships/transport;
(3) whole-Sea organization/closure. Exact dimensional coupling OPEN.

For gamma:[0,1]->B_Sea investigate partial Road transport:
T_gamma : Adm_gamma(F_a) ⇀ F_b.
Road is connection-like CANDIDATE, not a proved differential-geometric connection.

Closed-loop holonomy is CANDIDATE. Hard target: no inter-fiber communication without
admitted Rainbow Road traversal.

# Chirality / Binary / Byte Reconciliation

Binary occupancy support: o:D->{0,1}.
Occupied loci may carry C={R,O,Y,G,B,V}.
Occupancy, chromatic state, adjacency, orientation and History remain distinct.

Example support 0 1 1 0 1 0 0 1 may carry 0 G G 0 R 0 0 Y.
Same binary occupancy != same Chirality state.
Design maxim: do not replace the bit; lift binary support into geometry.

R62 hierarchy remains Tile -> Seed(2x2) -> Byte/Bite(2x2x2 set-lift)
-> Block(4x4x4) -> recursive Fabric. Exact Seed->Byte lift OPEN.

Cube realization gives six 2x2 face restrictions plus adjacency/orientation/path
structure. DP-004's "six faces are Seeds" must be reconciled against R62 rather than
silently promoted. Exact face status and color/readout composition OPEN.

White = proposed combined/superposed spectral expression; exact algebra OPEN.
Black deferred.

Conventional files may be State Geometrics with G_file <-> b in {0,1}*.
Round-trip identity contract remains to be formalized.

# Rainbow Road — Nervous System

Canonical Road remains persistent ordered composition/history of closed Portals.
DP-006 system role: Rainbow Road is Genesis nervous system/domain-spanning transport.

Corridor = admissible route/continuation.
Portal = typed realized traversal.
Road preserves declared obligations and History, including Portal ancestry, waypoint
continuity, capacity, Resolution/Bandwidth envelope, Chirality trajectory, holonomy
witness, partial-failure History and Road identity.

Working authority direction: cross-domain privilege is an admissible Geometric/Road
relationship, not merely an unscoped Boolean packet flag.

Under fibered Sea, Road connection-like transport remains CANDIDATE.
Guardian may have system-wide Road authority but may not fabricate a Corridor that
does not mathematically exist.

# Genesis Language + Trinity Crosswalk

The existing Genesis Language is preserved.

Frontend already provides:
.gen -> typed AST -> semantic lowering -> GIR-MODULE -> checker/linker -> GVM.

Relationship-first roots already align:
en = bind identity/result; rel = relationship; ve = Portal-mediated transport;
ar = inheritance; tor = Portal closure.

Working crosswalk:
GEOMETRIC -> State/native semantic object.
rel -> Shell relationship construction.
portal -> Rainbow Road request.
ve -> Road transport.
tor -> Portal closure/receipt.
capability declaration -> software request/declaration of authority.
capability enforcement -> Road/Nexus/Guardian boundary.
GIR -> candidate computational projection of Shell semantic geometry.
GVM/bytecode/registers -> reference/host realization unless separately proven native.
BRANE M5/B6 -> donor/request-relative realization, not automatically R5/H6.

Git's no-hidden-CPU rule controls: registers, stack frames, LOAD/STORE and binary
arithmetic may be lowering targets without becoming Genesis ontology.

Engineering Trinity:
Hardware = realizes Genesis.
Software = expresses Genesis.
Guardian = governs/manages Genesis.

Do not confuse this with the Mathematics/Semantic Language/Programming Language
authority grouping or Trinity 3.0 donor coordinates.

The Trinity cuts across State, Nexus, Shell, Sea and Rainbow Road rather than mapping
one-to-one to domains.

# Guardian Intelligence Framework
Status: WORKING ARCHITECTURAL MODEL; canonical Guardian spec was OPEN at baseline.

Guardian is the top-level adaptive management/intelligence authority of the
instantiated Genesis Environment.

Guardian has system-wide potential write reach, but universal reach is not
mathematically unconstrained mutation.

Fundamental law:
Authority selects among mathematically admissible states; authority does not enlarge
the mathematical state space.

Guardian has maximum actor authority inside the Genesis domain and zero authority to
make a non-Genesis state valid by assertion.

Validation order:
1. well-formedness;
2. Genesis mathematical validity;
3. present admissibility;
4. actor authorization;
5. realization;
6. authoritative closure.

Guardian may occupy the highest actor-authorization class while remaining bounded by
steps 1-3 and by closure/invariants.

Guardian roles:
observe; maintain live system model; predict; recommend/select among admissible
possibilities; coordinate; verify; detect; respond; recover; manage.

Guardian should have universal management write authority but not invisible bypass
authority. Guardian-originated writes should traverse the appropriate Road/Nexus/
closure mechanisms and leave witnesses/receipts with identity, reason, authority,
route, realization, before/after state, History and provenance.

Under fibered Sea, investigate one Guardian identity/framework with distributed local
manifestations per computational fiber. Exact distribution/identity mathematics OPEN.

Guardian may itself have Genesis-native state and may self-update only through valid,
admissible Genesis transformations. It cannot authorize its own escape from Genesis
mathematical constraints.

Guardian is the active/intelligent member of the Hardware/Software/Guardian Trinity:
Hardware realizes; Software expresses; Guardian governs.

# _bricked Role

_bricked remains both native capture-the-flag game and Genesis architecture proving
ground.

Design triad:
game mechanic <-> architecture property <-> security test.

Puzzle/test families may exercise Resolution, Bandwidth, Chirality/orientation,
DECS/History/provenance, Corridors, Portals, Road routing, Nexus mediation, State
recovery, replay/rollback, route degradation, scope escalation and multi-fiber Sea
navigation.

Virtual Boxing/Ghosting remain isolated authorized testing concepts.
CDN/DECS remains security research input, not completed cryptography.
